crossRefs.note: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look, and fail with longing for them all…
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me…
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

translations.web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
translations.bsb: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
translations.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort
translations.asv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?
